name: Edna the Witch
original_name: エドナ・ザ・ウィッチ
source:
A proud knightly "witch" who enjoys fighting.
She is neutral and does not belong to any faction.

Her signature weapon is a one-handed broadsword.

[Translated from the [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/character2.html]official website[/url]]
